summary.text: Sharon Shewmake is a Washington state senator for the 42nd District, sworn into office on December 9, 2022. Her official biography says she chairs the Senate Environment, Energy & Technology Committee and serves on the Agriculture & Natural Resources and Transportation committees.

paragraphs.text: The page says Shewmake is the first Democrat to represent the 42nd District in two decades.
It describes her focus as housing and energy affordability, jobs and infrastructure, and safe communities.

It also says she is a professor of environmental economics, urban economics and energy policy at Western Washington University in Bellingham, a children's book author, and the mother of two young boys.
